title: AutoNumberField's read display hard-codes text-gray-700 with no dark-mode colour (the face SummaryField had before #34182)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of the #34182 dev (os-dev-report 6996399017 on the card, PR #35269), class a, read in code only (no live repro). Filed by area ux-2 at the L1-a reviewer's ask (ACCEPT 6996715024).
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/AutoNumberField.tsx`, published `@object-ui/fields`). Suggested-grade: p3 · the record page reads `auto_number` through `TextField`, so the face reaches only the form widget's read display.
Dedupe: `AutoNumberField text-gray-700 dark` — none.

## 维护者速读

自动编号字段的只读展示把文字颜色写死成 `text-gray-700`，没有暗色变体；暗色模式下这段文字会发暗。#34182（PR #35269）给汇总字段修了同样的问题，改用主题色 `text-foreground`，自动编号这一个没在那张卡范围里。

## Facts (origin/main)

- `AutoNumberField.tsx` read display: fixed `text-gray-700`, no `dark:` variant.
- PR #35269 moved `SummaryField`'s read display to `text-foreground` (the token the record row's value container sets) and pinned "no fixed `text-(gray|slate|zinc|neutral|stone)-N`".

## Ask

Give `AutoNumberField`'s read display the same theme token, with the same pin shape as #34182's (`summaryFaces.numberFace-11752.test.tsx`). Ablate red.

⛔ Not a claim.
